Our story

Built in India. Driven by those who serve.

01

The question

Chapter 01 of 06

01 / The question

Tsalla Aerospace began with a question: what would it take to build aircraft that could think, navigate and operate when the conditions around them became uncertain?

02 / The return

For our founder, Vinayak Tsalla, that question became a reason to return to India after studying and working in Europe. The ambition was to build indigenous aerospace technology and bring together the people willing to take on its hardest problems.

03 / The first builds

Our beginnings were hands-on: small teams, early prototypes and the demanding work of turning engineering into flight. Every build exposed something new. Every test forced us to examine our assumptions. Progress came through persistence, evidence and a willingness to start again when the results demanded it.

04 / A sharper purpose

Working with India’s armed forces gave that ambition a sharper purpose. The challenge was no longer simply whether an aircraft could fly. It was whether it could help someone operating in a confined compartment, over a moving ship or far from reliable navigation and communications. Those realities continue to shape what we build.

05 / Today

Today, our work brings together uncrewed aircraft, onboard intelligence, resilient connectivity and the software that connects them. We are developing systems that can take on more of the complexity of a mission, giving the people operating them greater awareness and more room to focus on the decisions that matter.

06 / The next chapter

Our next chapter carries that same conviction at a larger scale.

We are building towards an India that can design, prove, produce and continually improve the technology it depends on. That capability takes years of engineering, people who care about the outcome, and trust earned through performance.

Our story is still being written—in the workshop, in the code, and in every flight that moves us forward.

The purpose remains the same: protect those who protect us.

OUR VALUES

01

Lead with Vision

Empowering the next generation of aerospace leaders through bold vision and unwavering commitment to innovation.

02

Precision in Execution

Every detail matters. We strive for perfection in every system we build, ensuring reliability when it matters most.

03

Radical Responsibility

We own our outcomes. No excuses, just solutions. We take full ownership of our missions and our impact on the world.

04

Put The Team First

We are one team committed to the common mission. We place the success of the team ahead of our individual success.

05

Embrace Teammates

We love and respect our teammates, trusting their good intentions even when results fall short.

06

Demonstrate Grit

We have the passion and perseverance to meet our goals. We work tirelessly to achieve lofty objectives.

07

Dominate

We do not seek to merely win but win so dominantly that competitors fear our capabilities. We demonstrate the courage, confidence, and capacity to pursue and achieve game-changing objectives.

08

Always Be Kind

We respect everyone, inside and outside our walls. Kindness is the foundation of our culture and our collaborations.
